subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist has named the woman as the mastermind behind Janussi's death and claims she had no knowledge that others knew of her involvement.

subject: The Woman (Unnamed)
fact: The woman is relieved, not sad, about Janussi's death; she has decided she has already won and is strategically relaxed, using apparent outrage to deflect suspicion.
source_quote: She was not sad. She was relieved. Her hands were too relaxed.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan has been reinstated to his former position and is now in charge of the investigation; he promised to ensure the adventurers' voices would be heard in his report.
source_quote: He promised our voices would be heard.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is skeptical of official narratives and pushes for calling out deception; he noticed the red herring in the safe’s contents.
source_quote: Thorin asked whether there was a red herring in there. There was, in fact — one of the coins had a herring stamped on it, and it was red.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has a theory about interrogation tactics, believing in withholding critical details to provoke deceptive responses; he recognized the duality in the woman’s motives.
source_quote: She was delighted to have us wrapped up and out of everything, no more heads poking anywhere. Win and win.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used his Glabbagool arm to steal the potion of flying from the table during the chaos; he acted while everyone else was distracted.
source_quote: I had my Glabbagool arm swipe the potion of flying off the table. Everyone was frantic... nobody watched my hand.

subject: The Avowed
fact: The Avowed are a governing body that holds authority over trials, naming ceremonies, and leadership succession; they are currently managing the aftermath of Janussi’s death.
source_quote: That will be done after the naming, by the new head of the Avowed.

subject: Opening of Alkrist's Safe
fact: The safe was opened under guard; its contents included a potion of flying, a healing potion, a heap of gold coins, and one red herring-stamped coin — no incriminating evidence was found.
source_quote: Inside: a potion of flying, a healing potion, a heap of gold coins, and nothing at all that pointed anywhere.

subject: Potion of Flying
fact: The potion of flying was stolen by Zalthir via his Glabbagool arm during the distraction of the safe’s opening; it is now in his possession.
source_quote: I had my Glabbagool arm swipe the potion of flying off the table.

subject: Red Herring Coin
fact: One gold coin from the safe bore a stamped image of a red herring — a deliberate red herring planted to mislead investigators.
source_quote: one of the coins had a herring stamped on it, and it was red.

subject: Sapphire
fact: A sapphire was sought via Locate Object spell to determine if the woman was carrying one; the spell detected nothing, suggesting she did not have it.
source_quote: I wanted to know if she had one on her — that would have been interesting. The spell went out and found nothing.

subject: Glabbagool (Arm)
fact: Glabbagool is a sentient, semi-independent arm attached to Zalthir; it has a preference for the skill of flight and acted autonomously to steal the potion.
source_quote: Under the skin of my arm, Glabbagool liked the flying skill. He thought it was a good skill.

subject: Who Killed Janussi?
fact: The true killer remains unknown; while the woman is suspected of orchestrating the crime, it is unclear whether she performed the polymorph or if an accomplice did.
source_quote: We don't know that part. She agreed. We did not.

subject: Accomplices in Janussi's Death
fact: It is suspected that accomplices exist, but their identities are unknown; the group has chosen to acknowledge their existence without naming them.
source_quote: Yeah — we know there are accomplices," I said.

subject: The Box She Built
fact: The woman has successfully isolated the adventurers, neutralized their influence, and secured her position by making them believe they are protected — while in fact, they are contained.
source_quote: She had built a box and we had walked into it.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: Deneir's Sanctum is the destination to which the adventurers are being escorted; it is implied to be a place of confinement or observation.
source_quote: I will now ask Kalan Strongbranch to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum.

subject: Prisons
fact: Alkrist is being held securely in the prisons; the safe was opened under guard, but Alkrist is no longer accessible for questioning.
source_quote: Alkrist held secure in the prisons.

subject: After the Naming
fact: Formal trials and judgments regarding Janussi’s death will occur after the naming ceremony, when the new head of the Avowed assumes power.
source_quote: That will be done after the naming, by the new head of the Avowed.

subject: The Society of Criminal Elements
fact: A hidden network of criminal elements exists within the society; the woman claims concern for the adventurers' safety, but her fear is genuine and strategic.
source_quote: There are other criminal elements within the society, and I would hate for something terrible to happen to you.
